newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end barely changed, rangebound.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end barely changed, rangebound.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed a thinly traded session barely firmer.
Activity remained confined to an 0.80-cent range amid a dearth of news. Market sources said prices could continue to trade sideways ahead of the cold season, which begins in a month.
Volume was estimate at only 800 lots.
Most-active January settled 0.30 cent firmer at 99.90 cents a lb after trading from 100.10 to 99.30. The back months finished 0.25 to 0.90 higher.
Nearby support was pegged at 97.50 for January juice, with resistance at an uptrend line at 102.50.

Officials of Louis Dreyfus Citrus SA said today the company is seeking acquisitions in Florida. The company in September purchased Winter Garden Citrus, a Florida processor, in a deal whose details were not made available to the public.
Industry sources were unfamiliar with the details but were not surprised by the plan.
"Now that they have a plant they need oranges to process rather than buying them from other growers," an analyst said.
Louis Dreyfus Citrus is the world's third-largest orange juice producer.
